dialog.speaker: npc:stranger
dialog.tr: Yastık menümüzde dokuz çeşit var. Karabuğday, lavanta, bir de "sert ama anlayışlı".
dialog.en: Our pillow menu has nine options. Buckwheat, lavender, and one called "firm but understanding."

choices.en: Order all nine to the room
Stay with the pillow from home

dokuz.tr: Dokuz yastık odaya geldi. Gece ikiye kadar denedin, yedincide uyuyakaldın.
dokuz.en: Nine pillows arrived. You tested until two in the morning and fell asleep on number seven.

coach.tr: Yedinci kazandı. Adını kimse not etmedi.
coach.en: Number seven won. Nobody wrote down its name.

ev.tr: Evden gelen yastıkla uyudun. Sekiz saat, kesintisiz.
ev.en: You slept on the pillow from home. Eight hours, uninterrupted.

coach.en: The menu stayed closed. Eight hours.

sert.tr: Yastık sertti. Sabah boynun tutulmuştu; resepsiyon bunu anlayışla karşıladı.
sert.en: The pillow was firm. In the morning your neck was stiff. The front desk was understanding.

coach.en: The firm part was the pillow. The understanding came from the desk.
